findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "get_arrivals_comparison" is 2538 chars, far longer than this server's median (388). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Return counted arrivals beside Meta outbound clicks for the authorized workspace and selected trailing window. difference is arrivals.value minus claimed_clicks…

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_cookie_scan" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_arrivals_comparison" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
